title: Battle of Koçhisar
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Koçhisar", at revision 1374080221, opens: "The Battle of Koçhisar took place in May 1516 at the DedeKargın location near Mardin Kızıltepe, between Ottoman army under the command of Bıyıklı Mehmed Pasha and the Safavid army under the command of Ustaclu Kara Han." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q85972229, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1516 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
